summary.ko: 대사 명료도·노이즈·음량 문제를 진단해 편집자가 적용할 처리 순서를 만듭니다.
summary.en: Diagnose dialogue and mix issues and propose a restrained, reproducible cleanup chain.

required_inputs.description: Inspectable audio or concrete measurements and problem samples
Target listening context and any supplied loudness requirements

workflow.instruction: Identify clipping, hum, noise, room echo, abrupt edits, level inconsistency, and competing music where evidence permits.
Separate recoverable problems from missing or irreversibly distorted signal.
Propose an ordered cleanup and mixing chain with conservative starting settings and listening checkpoints.
Define before-and-after checks for intelligibility, artifacts, loudness, peaks, and transitions; avoid claiming improvement without listening.

deliverables.name: Audio treatment plan
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Lists observed issues, proposed processing order, starting points, and validation checks

limitations: Do not infer technical defects from a transcript alone.
Irreversible clipping and missing speech may require a new recording.
permission_boundaries: Do not clone voices, generate replacement speech, or upload private audio externally.
Do not install paid plugins or purchase sound libraries.
